overview: Research draft record, unpublished: every statement below is an unverified lead, not a verified fact. A medical university in Kharkiv, north-eastern Ukraine, whose international applicants are handled by an Educational and Scientific Institute for Foreign Citizens. This draft is gated on operating conditions: Kharkiv is a front-line region, and no part of this record may be published until a dated official statement says where and how teaching takes place in the current academic year. Draft record built from search-snippet leads on 2026-10-11; every field below is awaiting verification against the official pages listed under research references and nothing here is presented as a current fact.
